performance_question: Did design perform under target and near-miss events without transferring unacceptable risk downstream?
Did the ecosystem buffer survive, maintain function, and deliver stated co-benefits without unmanaged harms?
Did new code/standard change actual permits, inspections, and loss outcomes?
Did acquired/relocated area remain open-space or safe-use and did relocation outcomes hold?
Did elevation, retrofit, hardening, or equipment replacement protect household function in later events?
